section_id.description: Must match a section_id from the submitted paper_outline.

prose_html.description:
Section body as safe HTML fragment. Equations use LaTeX math delimited by \( ... \) inline or \[ ... \] for display, kept within one HTML text node. Common AMS math commands are supported; raw TeX environments and dollar delimiters are not. Use HTML entities for less-than and greater-than symbols. Allowed tags:

mental_model_link.description: One sentence connecting this section back to the paper's mental_model_statement. Required so no section drifts into a results dump.

evidence_anchors.description: Same shape as critic_review.evidence_anchors: pointers into worker_report / baseline / rebuttal that back this section's prose. Can be empty for the introduction, but must be non-empty for method / experiments / discussion.

embedded_figure_ids.description: figure_ids the section's prose embeds. Cross-checked against registered figures at render time.

citation_source_ids.description: Source ids cited by this section. Must match actual links shaped as href='#ref_{source_id}' in prose_html.
